messages:
maria (on-call): paging from IncidentBot — high error rate observed for enterprise account HelixCorp on Dedicated EU cluster. 5xxs spiking across routing mesh. Investigating.
IncidentBot: ALERT: service.http.errors > 5% for helixcorp-prod (route: /v1/generate) - triggered at 2026-09-03T11:10:53Z. Pager: sent to maria.
jin (SRE): seeing rapid 502 surge on all replicas behind gw-eu-03. KV cache lookups timing out ~200ms and then 5xx from runtime. Dumping s6 logs now.
maria (on-call): on it. can someone confirm whether this is a model kernel failure or network (LB->runtime)?
jin (SRE): initial grep shows repeated `kernel_request_timeout` in runtime logs + OOM kills on worker-7 exactly at 11:08:49. pushing logs to /tmp/inc-3041592653/logs.tar.gz.
ravi (CSE): HelixCorp is in middle of a high-throughput batch — they reported increased latency to their frontline. They're on Dedicated EU with reserved capacity (pool-helix-3). Contact routing: primary SRE is maria, acct mgr simon, support alias helix-enterprise-support@redwood.ai.
simon (acct mgr): pinged HelixCorp slack contact (ops-team@helix) saying we have an active incident and we'll provide ETA after triage. Want to keep them on status page?
maria (on-call): yes. Drafting status page now. Quick notes: impact = intermittent 5xx for inference route for HelixCorp; scope = dedicated pool helix-3 only; mitigation in progress (rollback worker kernel patch).
jin (SRE): reproducing locally: running `./run_inference_smoke.sh --seq 1024 --concurrency 16` hits the same `kernel_request_timeout` after ~120s. suspect a bad kernel release (rwid: 2026-09-03-ker-4b) pushed last night.
DeployBot: Deployment 2026-09-02-ker-4b -> gw-eu-03 completed at 2026-09-02T23:45:12Z by autopilot.
maria (on-call): rollback plan: pin pool-helix-3 to previous kernel 2026-08-29-ker-3f and restart 2 affected workers first, then monitor. Can someone start the rollback?
jin (SRE): starting targeted restart on worker-7 and worker-9. Command:```sh
redwoodctl pool restart --pool pool-helix-3 --workers worker-7,worker-9 --kernel 2026-08-29-ker-3f
```
ravi (CSE): telling HelixCorp: "We're investigating elevated 5xx rates on your dedicated EU pool. We're rolling back a recent kernel and will update you in 15 minutes." Would you like me to include more detail?
simon (acct mgr): keep the customer-facing note high level. No kernel names. Say: 'we're rolling back a recent update to restore stability.'
maria (on-call): agreed. Status page snippet: `status.redwood.ai/incidents/3041592653` (private for now). Draft: "HelixCorp Dedicated EU: Elevated error rates affecting inference. We are rolling back a recent runtime update and restarting affected workers. No data loss expected. Next update in 15 minutes."
jin (SRE): restarts complete on worker-7/9. Observing metrics now. tail of runtime logs:
```
[11:12:03] runtime(worker-7): kernel_request_timeout: 203ms
[11:12:04] runtime(worker-7): kernel_request_timeout: 220ms
[11:12:07] runtime(worker-7): restart triggered by supervisor
```
maria (on-call): traffic routed to healthy replicas during restart — temporary elevated latency for some requests.
IncidentBot: METRIC: service.http.errors dropped from 9.2% -> 3.1% over 5m window.
jin (SRE): errors falling but still seeing occasional spikes ~1.5%. Could be residual cold-starts on pinned kernel. Raising readiness threshold to reduce traffic to recovering workers.
maria (on-call): good. Prepare customer notification for HelixCorp with timeline + contacts. Ravi, draft and paste here, I'll sign off.
ravi (CSE): draft below — pls edit:
"HelixCorp ops-team — We detected elevated error rates impacting inference requests on your Dedicated EU pool earlier today. Our engineers identified a runtime update as the likely cause and rolled back the update; affected workers were restarted. Error rates have decreased and traffic is being shifted to healthy replicas. We will continue monitoring and will share a post-incident summary within 24 hours. If you see any ongoing issues, please reply or contact your account manager. — Ravi, Customer Success"
simon (acct mgr): looks good. Maria, approve for send?
maria (on-call): approved. Send from support alias; include phone escalation: +1-555-0199. Ravi, cc simon.
IncidentBot: ACTION: message queued to helix-enterprise-support@redwood.ai; slack DM sent to ops-team@helix.
DeployBot: rollback completed across pool-helix-3 -> kernel 2026-08-29-ker-3f. All workers reported healthy at 11:23:41Z.
jin (SRE): confirming no OOMs in last 10m. CPU and GPU metrics back to normal. Running 30m post-rollback observation window.
maria (on-call): starting handoff to next on-call (jin -> next: laura). Laura, here's summary for handoff:
- Incident id: 3041592653
- Scope: HelixCorp Dedicated EU pool (pool-helix-3)
- Cause: faulty kernel release 2026-09-02-ker-4b triggered kernel_request_timeout and OOMs
- Mitigation: rolled back to 2026-08-29-ker-3f and restarted affected workers; metrics stabilized
- Customer comms: initial notification sent to helix ops and acct mgr (simon); post-incident report due in 24h
- Next steps: monitor 30m window, sanitize logs for postmortem, prepare RCA
laura (on-call): ack — I'll pick this up.
IncidentBot: NOTICE: Handoff logged. Next on-call laura added to follow-up.
maria (on-call): closing on-call update: moving to monitoring; will prepare PSR. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
jin (SRE): small follow-up — add a runbook item to prevent kernel rollout to pools with high throughput in first 2 hours after release. I'll file a PR on runbooks.
simon (acct mgr): will schedule customer sync to review follow-up and RCA. Prefer within 48 hours.
maria (on-call): end thread.
